name: WAVEFRNT
recent: WaveFront Berhad 于2026年11月25日发布截至2026年9月30日的季度业绩。新闻指出，2027财年第二季营收同比增长61.2%至1.3368亿令吉，并转亏为盈。公司于2026年8月28日更换首席财务官，并于9月9日变更注册地址。
notable: 2027财年第二季营收同比增长61.2%至1.3368亿令吉，并转亏为盈。
公司更换首席财务官，原首席财务官 Loh Choo Shien 卸任。
公司注册地址发生变更。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日季度，营收为8911.7万令吉，环比增长13.8%，同比下降7.5%；净亏损560.7万令吉，净利率为-6.3%，而上一季度净利率为0.1%。

recent_en: WaveFront Berhad released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 25 November 2026. News reported that 2Q FY2027 revenue jumped 61.2% YoY to RM133.68 million and the company swung back to profit. The company changed its principal officer on 28 August 2026 and changed its registered address on 9 September 2026.
notable_en: 2Q FY2027 revenue jumped 61.2% YoY to RM133.68 million and the company swung back to profit.
The company changed its principal officer, with Mr Loh Choo Shien ceasing to be the principal officer.
The company changed its registered address.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM89.117 million, up 13.8% QoQ and down 7.5% YoY; net loss was RM5.607 million with a net margin of -6.3%, compared to a net margin of 0.1% in the previous quarter.
